headline: Bitcoin is near $58,400 after the US proposed new tariffs on 14 economies and the Nasdaq fell about 4%, while hotter-than-expected core inflation kept a December Fed rate hike priced in.

stories.title: US proposes tariffs of up to 35% on 14 economies; bitcoin drops to about $57,500 as the Nasdaq falls about 4%
stories.summary: The US Trade Representative proposed new tariffs on 14 economies on Wednesday. Tech stocks sold off hard at the US open and bitcoin fell with them, trading more like a risky tech stock than a safe haven.
points: USTR proposed tariffs of up to 35% on Vietnam, up to 25% on India, up to 20% on China and Singapore, up to 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, up to 15% on Japan, Korea, Switzerland and Taiwan, and 15% on the EU, per its release.
The tariffs are proposals: public comments are due 5 January 2027 and hearings start 25 January 2027, per USTR. No decision was made on Mexico or Norway.
Bitcoin hit a session low of $57,500 on Wednesday morning, down more than 4% over 24 hours, per CoinDesk. It is down 24% in November and on track for an eighth straight weekly loss.
The Nasdaq was down 4.15% and Nvidia down 8.35% after the open, per CoinDesk; Bespoke says that leaves the Nasdaq about 20% below its record.
Crypto.news counted $87 million of bitcoin liquidations over 24 hours before the inflation data.

stories.title: Core inflation comes in hotter than expected; a December Fed hike stays priced in and bitcoin funds lose money a sixth day
stories.summary: October's PCE report, the Fed's preferred inflation measure, showed core prices rising 3.3% over the year, a touch above forecasts. Growth was also much stronger than expected. Markets still see a rate hike at the Fed's 9 December meeting as almost certain.
points: Headline PCE inflation was 3.8% on the year (September 3.6%) and core 3.3% against 3.2% expected (September 3.1%), per CoinDesk.
Third-quarter growth was revised up to 4.3% from 3.4%, per CoinDesk; the forecast had been 3.5%, per TipRanks.
Bitcoin Magazine put the chance of a quarter-point hike at the 8-9 December meeting at 98%. CoinDesk says a January hike is priced at roughly 60%.

US spot bitcoin funds lost $231.4 million on Tuesday 24 Nov, their sixth straight day of outflows, taking November's outflows to about $4.94 billion, per Farside data reported by CoinDesk. Wednesday's figure is not out yet.

stories.title: Companies that hold crypto on their books feel the strain: Bit Digital sells ether to repay a loan, Ark trims its own bitcoin fund
stories.summary: Listed companies that hold bitcoin or ether are under pressure as prices fall. Many US retail traders own these stocks to get crypto exposure, and selling to pay debts or index changes can add to price drops.
points: Bit Digital sold 29,825 ETH between 15 and 23 Nov at an average of $1,676 and repaid $50 million of a loan from Galaxy; another $50 million is still owed, per The Block.
Ark Invest sold $6.81 million of shares in its own Ark 21Shares bitcoin fund on Tuesday, per The Block.
Strategy (MSTR) shares closed down 8.12% at $77.55 on Tuesday, per Bitcoin Magazine.
MSCI will remove Strategy from its global indexes at the close on 30 November, effective 1 December, per FinanceFeeds.

briefs.title: US prosecutors file a complaint over USDC in wallets hijacked in the Binance hack
briefs.summary: A Justice Department complaint filed 23 Nov targets USDC in 32 Binance addresses that North Korea's Lazarus Group took over in the 29 Oct hack. The wallets hold nearly $342 million and Circle agreed to keep them blocked, per Protos.

briefs.title: Franklin Templeton fund to add Hyperliquid's HYPE
briefs.summary: Franklin Templeton's EZPZ crypto index fund will start holding HYPE on or around 1 December, per a 25 Nov SEC filing reported by crypto.news.

briefs.title: Utah moves to drop criminal charges against Kalshi
briefs.summary: After Kalshi blocked Utah users, the state's attorney general moved to dismiss the charges without prejudice, which means they could be refiled, per KSL.

briefs.title: CFTC lets some derivatives firms count bitcoin and ether toward reserves
briefs.summary: A CFTC staff advisory lets some exchanges and clearinghouses count ether, bitcoin and payment stablecoins, after a haircut, toward one year of operating-expense reserves, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bithumb says its October breach exposed more customer data
briefs.summary: South Korea's Bithumb says the breach exposed ID and bank details but no crypto was stolen, and it warns of phishing that pretends to be the exchange, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: NovaTech founders ordered to pay over $1.3 million
briefs.summary: A New York court ruled against the founders of the NovaTech crypto Ponzi scheme, which hit at least 11,000 New Yorkers, per The Block.

briefs.title: UniCredit offers Italian savers a capital-protected bitcoin product
briefs.summary: The six-year certificate promises the money back at maturity, caps the gross gain at 65% and starts at €1,000, per The Block.

briefs.title: Japan's SBI and SMFG start a Solana joint venture
briefs.summary: SBI, SMFG and the Solana Foundation launched SBI Solana Global to work on stablecoin payments and tokenization, per The Block.
